The structure features a central niche containing a statue of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ child, flanked by elaborate golden columns and decorative elements. The altar is framed by massive stone pillars on the left and right, leading up to an arched ceiling. The lighting is warm and dramatic, highlighting the gold leaf details against darker background niches.
